top_signals.title: Philippine Bourse Expects Less Brokers Amid SEC’s Capital Hike
top_signals.summary: The Philippines’ stock market operator sees a reduction in stock brokerage firms should the Securities & Exchange Commission go ahead with a plan to increase capitalization requirements.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Rescue Efforts Ongoing After Deadly Nepal Flood
top_signals.summary: Rescue efforts are ongoing after a deadly flash flood that sent a wall of mud and water tearing through Himalayan river valleys on the China-Nepal border. The disaster, triggered by a landslide, has resulted in more than 150 confirmed deaths with hundreds still missing. Bloomberg's Swati Pandey shares the latest updates. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Japanese startups, IPOs set for boost with platform to trade unlisted companies
top_signals.summary: The Japanese regulator's registration of a new trading platform for unlisted shares could help create a more favorable capital-raising environment for the country's IPO ecosystem.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
